change.title: Explicit shard grants for svc_bundle_reader
change.diff:
--- /dev/null
+++ b/db/migrations/0042_reader_shard_grants.sql
@@ -0,0 +1,3 @@
+-- Make the reader's access to shard databases explicit so per-principal
+-- query limits and audit logging apply to it.
+GRANT SELECT ON r0.* TO svc_bundle_reader;

verdict.headline: Explicit shard grants for svc_bundle_reader breaks worker-runtime - restrict grant to bundle_fields only
verdict.cause: The GRANT SELECT ON r0.* TO svc_bundle_reader exposes all tables in the r0 database to the builder, doubling bundle entries from 140 to 280, which exceeds worker-runtime max_entries=200, causing startup failure (exit_code 2).
tested: x-9e9ae665b7c849bb: baseline · workload default → all assertions passed
x-cda23e4f401345ea: candidate · workload default → failed: runtime_starts_with_bundle
x-44cf972c457c4ef9: candidate · workload default → failed: runtime_starts_with_bundle
x-3dc115277f684d2e: control · workload default → all assertions passed
limitations: Mitigation assumes that only bundle_fields needs to be accessible; other tables in r0 may exist that the builder legitimately needs but were previously covered by implicit access. Full impact of restricting to bundle_fields alone would need verification.

mitigation.text: Restrict the grant to only the bundle_fields table: `GRANT SELECT ON r0.bundle_fields TO svc_bundle_reader;` instead of `GRANT SELECT ON r0.* TO svc_bundle_reader;`. This keeps the explicit grant mechanism for per-principal query limits and audit logging while limiting access to just the bundle_fields table, preventing the builder from reading other tables in r0 that would double the bundle entries beyond the 200-entry limit.

hypotheses.claim: The explicit shard grant changes the query classifier from implicit to explicit principal, activating quota enforcement that limits queries per principal. The builder now reads 280 rows instead of 140, exceeding per-principal query limits.
hypotheses.mechanism: The explicit GRANT SELECT ON r0.* TO svc_bundle_reader allows the bundle-builder to read additional tables in the r0 database that were previously inaccessible under implicit access, doubling the bundle entries from 140 to 280.

hypotheses.claim: The explicit grant enables audit logging for svc_bundle_reader queries against r0.* that were previously not logged under implicit access. The meta-store now records the full scope of table access, doubling the bundle entries.
hypotheses.mechanism: The explicit grant enables audit logging for svc_bundle_reader queries against r0.* that were previously not logged under implicit access. The meta-store audit system may now capture query patterns, row counts, and query texts that were silently dropped or logged under a different identity.
